transcript.content: Hello, welcome to the clinic. Can you tell me what brings you in today?

Well, my family says I’ve been doing too much. I don’t really see it that way. I’m just trying to get things done — the move, getting the new garage built right, helping organize things at church. And at work, I’ve been showing the younger guys how the job ought to be done. It feels like I’m the only one with enough drive to handle it all.
Have you noticed that you need less sleep lately, or that you feel rested even if you haven’t slept much?
I’m not really sure. I mean, I haven’t been paying close attention to it. Some nights I’m up doing things, but I can’t say for sure that I need less sleep or anything like that.
Have you been feeling more irritable or unusually upbeat lately?

Yeah… I guess I have. I feel pretty up at times, like I’m ten feet tall and everybody ought to just get with the program. Then somebody asks me one little question — my wife or my son — and I snap at them like they’re trying to slow me down. So yes, more irritable, and maybe more wound up than usual.
Have you had any periods recently where your mood was so high, irritable, or energized that it was noticeably different from how you usually feel?

Yes, I’d say so. Lately I’ll feel real high, like I’m ten feet tall, joking around and full of energy. Then if somebody isn’t going along with what I’m trying to do, I feel like they need to get on board or get out of my way. My wife or my boy will ask one small question, and I snap at them. That’s not how I usually am.
